name: DRACONID
source:
Draconid is a visual novel about identity and coming of age. As a human living impossibly far from home, you must make the most of your last autumn as a high school student and forge meaningful friendships with the drifting souls you meet. Your choices will determine who you follow, and whether they will succeed in their journey to figure out who they are and what they want to do in life—or whether you lose each other altogether.

[From [url=https://demyurge.itch.io/dragongame]Itch.io[/url]]
